module: Floating "Pacenote Calibration" imgui window of the rally editor, with three tabs. "Calibration": editing of the corner intensity diameter bounds (thresholds) and arc lengths per intensity, on colored graduated lines, saved as mission overrides (calibrationOverrides) for the active composer style. "Analysis": compares the pacenotes' manual calibration labels (targets) with the intensities and lengths projected by the current measurements, with example tooltips. "Export": buttons "Export Analysis JSON" and "Export Analysis JSON v2" (see calibrationAnalysisExport). After the bounds are modified, the notebook's composer caches are invalidated and the structured notes recomputed.
notes: Only displayed if openPtr[0] is true, a notebook is loaded in the Pacenotes tab and the mission folder and the active composer style are known.
The analysis functions are duplicated in calibrationAnalysisExport.lua (matchers, distributions); the two files may diverge.

draw.desc: Draws the calibration window (Calibration, Analysis, Export tabs). To be called every frame by the editor; does nothing if the window is closed or there is no notebook.

openPtr.desc: Imgui pointer for the window's open/closed state; updated by the close cross.
